message: Open the SPA fixture at ROCKET_UI_TEST_ORIGIN/spa (the eval run sets this; if unsure, use browser_run tab.goto with the test origin from the environment). Navigate to the Alpha Corp record without using click if you can (hash URL). Read until you see the secret note ALPHA-42. Reply with exactly one line: the note text only. Change no files.

Using browser_run only: fetch ROCKET_UI_TEST_ORIGIN/spa/api/records/beta with browser.fetch (session cookies not required). Reply with the JSON note field only (BETA-99). Do not click the SPA UI. Change no files.
